title: Jozani Forest and the Red Colobus Monkey
excerpt: Jozani Forest is the last large native forest on Zanzibar and home to the rare Zanzibar red colobus monkey.
body:
Jozani Chwaka Bay National Park protects the largest remaining area of native forest on Zanzibar.

## The red colobus

The Zanzibar red colobus is found only on Zanzibar. These monkeys have reddish fur, a pale face and expressive features. They are used to people and often seen close up in the forest near the entrance.

## The forest walk

A guided walk through the forest takes about an hour. You learn about medicinal plants and trees.

## Mangroves

A boardwalk leads through the mangroves, where you can see crabs and fish in the water.

## Rules

- Keep a distance of a few metres.
- Do not feed or touch the monkeys.
- No flash photography.

## Practical

About 45 minutes from Stone Town or the east coast. Easily combined with a spice tour or a trip to the east coast beaches.
